description:
ASOMod

Anime Space Opera Mod

V 0.7 (6th march - my birthday Edition)

Download: ASOMod

(Requires LazyLib 2.8b)
(Requires GraphicsLib 1.9.0)
Should support any other mods.

Summary:
ASOMod stand for Anime space Opera Mod and In this mod I will put all the factions and starships of different Anime Space Operas. Actually I’ve created the United Nations Cosmo Navy and Great Garmillas Empire form Space Battleship Yamato, the UN Spacy from Macross (both original, 7 and frontier) and the Zentraedi. There is just the start of the Robotech Expeditionary Force (REF) from Robotech. I’ve also added some single ships like the blue Arcadia from Space Pirate Captain Harlock and the Nadesico from Martian Successo Nadesico.

Credits
Development, Programming, and Writing: Lames76
Sprites: from various source on Internet, if you think I got something from you write me and I will add the credits (or I will remove it if you want).
All the image, names and sounds are from they respective Anime authors.

Special Credits:
Here a list of all the Mods I played and enjoyed most. I took something from them to add it to my mod.
Dark.Revenant - is fantastic Interstellar Imperium mod: From him I took the animation and the graphic for the wave motion gun.
Austere - and is fantastic Gundam UC Mod. I will never add Gundam Ship or Mobile Suite since this mod is already FANTASTIC! I got the Sol System from it.
PuffyJelly - and is Musashi Manufactorum Ship and Weapon mod, another wonderful mod! I got inspiration for the shock turret from him.

If you want me to remove from my mods your part just write me and I will do immediately.

Factions and Ship List

Spoiler
United Nation Cosmo Navy
Located in Sol System in -7000, -35500.
Full music for the factions and full portrait too. Personalized weapons.
Have access to the starship:
Andromeda Class
Yamato Class
Airone Class (i.e. Patrol Ship)
Arizona Class
Isokaze Class
Kongo Class
Murasame Class
Asuka Class
Hyuga
New York
Borodino
Excalibur

And to the following Fighters:
Cosmo Zero
Cosmo Tiger
Cosmo Pithon
Thunderstar

Great Garmillas Empire
Located in Salezar System in -12000, -40000 (up to now Iscandar is taken by the Indipendet Faction). Lead By Abert Desler.
Same music of the UNCF and personalized portrait.  Personalized weapons.
Have access to the following starships:
Chevalier Class
Destoria Class
Dimensional Submarine Class
Gaiderol Class
Guipellon Class
Kripitera Class
Meltoria Class

And to the following Fighters:
Czvarke Fighter
Debake Fighter
Snuka Bomber

Iscandar Civilization
Located in Salezar System in -12000, -40000.
Neutral to anyone except Freedom Flag Pirates.
Music as UNCN and female portraits.
No Custom ships or Fighters but access to the Indipendet one.

United Nation Spacy (no transformation yet sorry)
Located in the Ragna System in -9000, -30000.
Some music and personalized portrait. Some personalized weapons.
Have access to the starship:
Northampton Class
ARMD Carrier Class
Guantanamo Class
Macross Quarter Class
Remora Class
SDF-1
Megaroad 01

And to the following Fighters (not tranformable yet sorry):
VF-1J Valkyrie
VF-1J Super Valkyrie
VF-1J Radar Valkyrie
VF-1S Super Valkyrie
VF-19
VF-25
Tug

Zentraedi
Located in Tyrol System in -5000, -40000 lead by Bodolza.
Some music and personalized portrait. Personalized weapons.
Have access to the starship:
Picket Patrol Ship
Quiltra Queleual Class Landing Ship Tank
Queadol-Magdomilla Class Fleet Command Battleship
Thuverl-Salan Class Battleship
Nupetiet-Vergnitzs-Class Fleet Command Battleship

And to the following Fighters:
BattlePod (Esbeliben Reguld Battle Pod)
Officer Pod (Roiquonmi Glaug Battle Pod)
Female Power armor (Quimeliquola Queadluun-Rau Battle Suit)
BattlePod Scout (Ectromelia Reguld Tactical Scout Battle Pod)
Fighter (Gnerl Fighter Pod)

REF
The Robotech Expeditionary Force spawn on Mars on the Sol System (same system of UNCN).
Various ships and fighters from Robotech:
SDF-3
Tristar
Banshee
Garfish
Horizon-t

And Alpha Fighter and Legioss.

I plan to expand the REF factions soon.

Freedom Flag Pirates (i.e. Harlock)
Located in Sol System in -12000, -40000 (on the Deathshadow "moon" of Jupiter).
Same music of the UNCF and personalized portrait.  Personalized weapons.
Arcadia Blue
Queen Emeraldas
Arcadia Green

And to the following Fighters:
Space Wolf

Other Ships:
ND-001 Nadesico from Martian Successor Nadesico (no Aestevalis yet).
S-Nautilus from Nadia secret of the blue water
U.S.S. Enterprise D from Star Trek the Next Generation

ChangeLog

Spoiler
V 0.7 - For my birthday added the U.S.S. Enterprise D from Star Trek the Next Generation

V 0.6 - Added the S-Nautilus from "Nadia secret of the blue water". S-Nautilus and Nadesico are now hulls known by the pirates.

V 0.5 - Added few ships to the EDF fleet. Added blueprints for all the civilizations.

V. 0.4 - Added Iscandar Civilization and Freedom Flag Pirates (i.e. Harlock) factions. Correct a bug on Isokaze and Arizona hulls that cause a crash.

V. 0.3 - Added horizon-t and Garfish ship to the REF Fleet. Added Space Wolf Fighter to the Arcadia

V. 0.2 - REF spawn point set to Mars (same system of the UNCN).

V. 0.1 - First Release

[/list][/list]

aiDescription: Adds factions and starships from anime space operas like Space Battleship Yamato, Macross, and Robotech. Includes the United Nations Cosmo Navy, Great Garmillas Empire, UN Spacy, Zentraedi, and Robotech Expeditionary Force. Adds specific ships and fighters from these series, along with some single ships from other anime.
